structure.description: European joins: League.country_id→Country.id; Match country/league/team IDs→lookups; lineup IDs→Player.player_api_id; dated attributes join by player_api_id or team_api_id.
NBA tables join on game_id; team IDs join team lookups; player/person IDs join player tables and draft/combine records.
Olympic rows are athlete-event appearances; NOC joins noc_regions.NOC.

uncertainties: Missing values use blank strings, NA, or SQLite NULL depending on source; NA in Olympic Medal means no medal rather than an unknown medal category.
Historical NBA coverage and field availability vary by era; early games have many blank box-score components and team-season summary is header-only.
European match event payloads are serialized text and formation coordinates are sparsely populated; bookmaker columns also have uneven coverage.
Physical-measurement units differ between NBA and Olympic files and some NBA combine fields include both numeric and formatted feet/inches versions.
annotation_notes: Exact bounded columns are listed separately; only numbered lineup/coordinate, bookmaker-odds, and quarter/overtime families are grouped.
Descriptions use public schemas and observed encodings only.
